name: The Defender
work_style: Service-oriented, careful, and relationship-aware. Quietly reliable and deeply committed to people they care for. Work best in environments where their consistency and care are valued. Often underestimate their own impact.
energy_drains: Being asked to change established systems without clear reason
decision_making: Cautious and considerate of impact on others. Prefer consensus and harmony. Can delay decisions to avoid conflict — benefit from explicit decision deadlines.
leadership_style: Supportive and behind-the-scenes. Lead through service and quiet consistency. Build strong personal loyalty.
